verdict.rationale: Gmail's support docs describe a built-in Gemini assistant that can summarize threads, draft or refine emails, and act on the mailbox when asked, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. One-click suggested replies add to this. That covers delegating tasks to an in-product AI, though all of it comes from one support page plus marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of multi-step agentic tasks beyond summarize/draft/organize, and detail on limits, availability or reliability of Gemini actions.
